messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: SEV2 - Onyx Corp (enterprise / VPC) eu-west1 - elevated 5xx and latency since 22:04Z. Auto-detect shows 18% 5xx for tenant onyx-eu. On-call: @alex (SRE). Link: https://grafana/redwood/onyx-eu (perf graphs)

alex (SRE): Taking. Initial triage: ingress gateways show TCP retransmits and connection resets from eu-west1. Dedicated pool shards for Onyx are up but requests queue.

maria (AE - Onyx): Customer reports API errors affecting critical checkout flows. They asked for ETA and mitigation now.

alex (SRE): Noted. Assessing whether this is infra (network) or app-level. If network, plan is region failover to warm pool in eu-west2 + DNS cutover with low TTL.

jess (Support): Onyx is on dedicated pool 'onyx-prod-eu'. If we shift, sticky session cookies might break. Need to coordinate app teams.

liam (Network Eng): Seeing elevated packet loss on peering to eu-west1 from carrier X. BGP flaps correlate with 22:02Z. I can open a carrier ticket but that will take time. Recommend redirecting traffic.

alex (SRE): Agreed. Plan: 1) Attach Onyx tenant to warm pool in eu-west2 (warm capacity pre-warmed). 2) Update DNS TTL to 30s and start phased cutover (10% -> 50% -> 100%) via our traffic-shift tool. 3) Keep dedicated pool draining in eu-west1 until sessions finish (grace 10m). 4) Notify customer and on-call handoff if prolonged.

maria (AE - Onyx): Confirm they want minimal downtime. Can Support provide a brief advisory we can send?

jess (Support): Drafting now. Will include expected short 10-15m failover window and ask them to clear long-lived connections.

alex (SRE): Executing warm attach: 
```
redwoodctl pool attach --tenant onyx --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2-warm --mode graceful --max-concurrency 500
```
Triggered at 22:12Z. Monitoring origin requests to warm pool.

ops-bot: action: pool-attach started (run_id: a1b2c3). Progress updates will be posted.

sam (SRE, on-call): I'll run the traffic shift when warm pool reports healthy. Oncall handover scheduled at 23:00Z; if this persists, I'll stay on until resolved.

alex (SRE): Warm pool health OK at 22:15Z. Running staged shift: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Command: 
```
traffic-shift start --tenant onyx --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --strategy staged --stages 10,50,100 --wait 60s
```
Initiated at 22:18Z.

incident-bot: ALERT -> Stage 1 complete (10%). Error rate decreased to 9%. Latency on eu-west1 still high.

jess (Support): Sent advisory to Onyx primary contacts at 22:20Z ("We are performing a controlled regional failover; expect brief increased latency during the shift.").

liam (Network Eng): Carrier acknowledged peering issue with eu-west1 and indicated ETA 40-60m. Good call to shift.

incident-bot: ALERT -> Stage 2 complete (50%). Error rate now 2.5% overall for Onyx.

alex (SRE): Observed a few 502s during stage transitions due to sticky session mismatch. Implemented temporary header rewrite to surface a consistent session cookie. Patch applied.

sam (SRE, on-call): Continuing to 100%. Monitoring for 10m before finalizing drain.

incident-bot: ALERT -> Stage 3 complete (100%). Traffic fully in eu-west2 at 22:27Z. Onyx 5xx back to baseline ~0.2%.

maria (AE - Onyx): Thanks, team. I'll notify the customer that traffic has been moved and services are stable. Please include ETA for full rollback or permanent switchover.

alex (SRE): We'll keep eu-west1 pool in drain for 30m to catch any stragglers then decommission the route. If carrier fixed, we can failback under controlled conditions, but recommend keeping eu-west2 as primary for next 24h while we validate.

jess (Support): Customer notified. They responded: "Thanks, we see things improving on our side." :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident-note: mitigation performed: regional failover via warm pool + staged DNS/traffic shift; root cause suspected carrier peering degradation. Follow-ups: start postmortem, network RCA with carrier, review sticky-session handling for dedicated pools.

sam (SRE, on-call): Handoff note: if any regressions occur after I sign off at 23:00Z, page me. Otherwise I'll document actions and assign follow-ups.

alex (SRE): Adding tasks to ticket: network-RCA, onyx-comm-log, session-rewrite postmortem.

maria (AE - Onyx): I'll coordinate a joint post-incident call with the customer tomorrow and include the timeline. Thanks everyone. :clap:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE -> mitigated at 22:27Z. Monitoring for 1h.
